state.description: Name of a state or region of a country.

type.description: Address type, e.g. WORK or HOME

CalendarMessageField.description: Message containing details about a calendar event.
CalendarMessageField.title: Calendar

title.description: The title is shown close to the button that leads to open a user calendar.

event_start.description: The timestamp defines start of a calendar event.

event_end.description: The timestamp defines end of a calendar event.

fallback_url.description: The URL that is opened when the user cannot open a calendar event directly or channel does not have support for this type.

phone_number.description: Phone number in E.164 with leading +.

title.description:
Title shown close to the phone number.
The title is clickable in some cases.

CardHeight.description: You can set the desired size of the card in the message.

x-enumDescriptions.UNSPECIFIED_HEIGHT: The height of the card is unspecified.

CardMessage.description: Message containing text, media and choices.
CardMessage.title: Card Message

choices.description: You may include choices in your Card Message. The number of choices is limited to 10.

description.description: This is an optional description field that is displayed below the title on the card.

title.description: The title of the card message.

media_message.description: A message containing a media component.

whatsapp_header.description: Optional. Sets the header for the footer of a WhatsApp reply button message, if there is no media in the message. Ignored for other channels. Ignored if not transcoded to a native WhatsApp message with reply buttons.

CarouselMessageField.description: Message containing a list of cards often rendered horizontally on supported channels.
CarouselMessageField.title: Carousel

cards.description: A list of up to 10 cards.

choices.description: Optional. Outer choices on the carousel level. The number of outer choices is limited to 3.

parameter_mappings.description: A mapping between omni-template variables and the channel specific parameters.

ChannelTemplateOverridesMap.description:
Field to override the omnichannel template by referring to a channel-specific template.
The key in the map must point to a valid conversation channel.
Currently only `WHATSAPP` and `KAKAOTALK` are supported

Choice.description: A choice is an action the user can take such as buttons for quick replies or other call to actions.
Choice.title: Choice message

ChoiceItem.title: Choice
ChoiceItem.description: A message component for interactive messages, containing a choice.

title.description: Required parameter. Title for the choice item.

description.description: Optional parameter. The description (or subtitle) of this choice item.

media.description: Optional parameter. The media of this choice item.

postback_data.description: Optional parameter. Postback data that will be returned in the MO if the user selects this option.

whatsapp_footer.description: Optional. Sets the text for the footer of a WhatsApp reply button or URL button message. Ignored for other channels.

choices.description: The number of choices is limited to 10.

birthday.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format.

DisplayMode.description: Controls the display behavior of a choice. Only supported for Choice Message on the RCS channel. Has no effect on other channels or message types, except for a carousel's outer choices, where it is rejected outright.

x-enumDescriptions.DISPLAY_MODE_UNSPECIFIED: Default. Transient — choice disappears when new messages arrive.
x-enumDescriptions.PERSISTENT: Persistent — choice remains visible in the message bubble.

type.description: Email address type. e.g. WORK or HOME.

ListItem.title: List Item
ListItem.description: Item containing either choiceItem or ProductItem

ListMessageField.title: List
ListMessageField.description: A message containing a list of options to choose from. All items must be of the same type.

title.description: A title for the message that is displayed near the products or choices.

description.description: This is an optional field, containing a description for the message.

sections.description: List of ListSection objects containing choices to be presented in the list message.

message_properties.description: Additional properties for the message. Required if sending a product list message.

catalog_id.description: Required if sending a product list message. The ID of the catalog to which the products belong.

menu.description: Optional. Sets the text for the menu of a choice list message.

whatsapp_header.description: Optional. Sets the text for the header of a WhatsApp choice list message. Ignored for other channels.

ListSection.title: List Section
ListSection.description: Section for interactive WhatsApp messages containing ListItem

title.description: Optional parameter. Title for list section.

label.description: Label or name for the position.

title.description: The title is shown close to the button or link that leads to a map showing the location. The title can be clickable in some cases.

MediaMessageField.title: Media Message
MediaMessageField.description: A message containing a media component, such as an image, document, or video.

thumbnail_url.description: An optional parameter. Will be used where it is natively supported.

prefix.description: Prefix before the name. e.g. Mr, Mrs, Dr etc.

phone_number.description: Phone number with country code included.

type.description: Phone number type, e.g. WORK or HOME.

ProductItem.title: Product
ProductItem.description: A message component for interactive messages, containing a product.

id.description: Required parameter. The ID for the product.

marketplace.description: Required parameter. The marketplace to which the product belongs.

quantity.description: Output only. The quantity of the chosen product.

item_price.description: Output only. The price for one unit of the chosen product.

currency.description: Output only. The currency of the item_price.

ShareLocationMessageField.description: Message requesting location from a user.
ShareLocationMessageField.title: Request location

title.description: The title is shown close to the button that leads to open a map to share a location.

fallback_url.description: The URL that is opened when channel does not have support for this type.

channel_template.description:
Optional. Channel specific template reference with parameters per channel.
The channel template if exists overrides the omnichannel template.
At least one of `channel_template` or `omni_template` needs to be present.
The key in the map must point to a valid conversation channel as
defined by the enum ConversationChannel.

TemplateReference.title: Template reference with concrete parameter values
TemplateReference.description: The referenced template can be an omnichannel template stored in Conversation API Template Store as an AppMessage. You may also reference external channel-specific templates, such as a WhatsApp Business Template. Note that channel-specific template references are not supported when populating the `explicit_channel_omni_message` field.

version.description:
Used to specify what version of a template to use. Required when using `omni_channel_override` and `omni_template` fields.
This will be used in conjunction with `language_code`. Note that, when referencing omni-channel templates using the [Sinch Customer Dashboard](https://dashboard.sinch.com/), the latest version of a given omni-template can be identified by populating this field with `latest`.

language_code.description:
The BCP-47 language code, such as `en_US` or `sr_Latn`.
For more information, see http://www.unicode.org/reports/tr35/#Unicode_locale_identifier. English is the default `language_code`.
Note that, while many API calls involving templates accept either the dashed format (`en-US`) or the underscored format (`en_US`), some channel specific templates (for example, WhatsApp channel-specific templates) only accept the underscored format. Note that this field is required for WhatsApp channel-specific templates.

parameters.description:
Required if the template has parameters. Concrete values must
be present for all defined parameters
in the template. Parameters can be different for
different versions and/or languages of the template.

template_id.description: The ID of the template. Note that, in the case of WhatsApp channel-specific templates, this field must be populated by the name of the template.

type.description: Optional. URL type, e.g. Org or Social

title.description: The title shown close to the URL. The title can be clickable in some cases.

postback_data.description: An optional field. This data will be returned in the ChoiceResponseMessage. The default is message_id_{text, title}.

language_code.description:
The BCP-47 language code, such as `en-US` or `sr-Latn`. For more information,
see https://www.unicode.org/reports/tr35/#Unicode_locale_identifier.

variables.description: List of expected variables. Can be used for request validation.

create_time.description: Timestamp when the translation was created.

update_time.description: Timestamp of when the translation was updated.

v2MessageTypes.description:
Must be one of the following: [text_message, card_message, carousel_message,
choice_message, location_message, media_message, template_message, list_message]

id.description:
The id of the template. Specify this yourself during creation.
Otherwise, we will generate an ID for you. This must be unique
for a given project.

version.description:
The version of the template. While creating a template, this will be defaulted to 1.
When updating a template, you must supply the latest version of the template in order for the update to be successful.

default_translation.description:
The default translation to use if not specified.
Specified as a BCP-47 `language_code` and the `language_code` must exist
in the translations list.

create_time.description: Timestamp of when the template was created.

update_time.description: Timestamp when the template was updated.
